name: safroquest
description: SafroQuest: a learn-and-contribute game for the Safrochain ecosystem

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @safroquest/api" "npm run dev -w @safroquest/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
